title: PastureTrace inbound event (v1)
description: An animal event sent from PastureTrace to a private Predator Watch tenant. It carries no location. Location stays in PastureTrace and is never sent in this message. Status: Planned.

tenant_id.description: Private tenant (organization) id in Predator Watch.

animal_id.description: The rancher's own animal or tag id, opaque to Predator Watch.

timestamp.description: When the event happened, RFC 3339 with offset.

confidence.description: PastureTrace's confidence in the event, 0 to 1.

propertyNames.description: Location fields are never allowed, under any of these names.
